name: CoTAttention

kernel_size.description: kernel size for contextual convolution; default 3

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, kernel_size=3):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if b == 0 or c == 0 or h == 0 or w == 0:
        return x
    groups = 4 if c % 4 == 0 else (2 if c % 2 == 0 else 1)
    mid = max(1, c // 4)
    key_embed = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(c, c, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size//2, groups=groups, bias=False),
        nn.ReLU()
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    value_embed = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(c, c, 1, bias=False),
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    attention_embed = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(2*c, mid, 1, bias=False),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Conv2d(mid, kernel_size*kernel_size*c, 1)
    ).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    k1 = key_embed(x)
    v = value_embed(x).view(b, c, -1)
    y = torch.cat([k1, x], 1)
    att = attention_embed(y)
    att = att.reshape(b, c, -1, h, w)
    att = att.mean(2).view(b, c, -1)
    k2 = F.softmax(att.float(), dim=-1).to(dtype=x.dtype) * v
    k2 = k2.view(b, c, h, w)
    return k1 + k2
